resources.string: Your library, on the big screen.
Choose your own ISO, CSO, CHD or PBP. It is copied and verified on this device before playing.
Add a game from a readable folder or USB drive. The original file is preserved.
Open PSP Dock 0308 on the console and connect its USB cable. You can inspect the connection or activate the PSP controller preview.
Only read access is requested. Selecting a folder does not yet prove that it belongs to the connected PSP.
This preview runs verified local games in the embedded engine. Saves remain on this device; returning saves to the PSP is not enabled.
Controller mode changes only the input session. This app does not write PSP files or certify safe USB removal.
PPSSPP is included in PSP Dock. Saves stay on this device.
Saves stay on this device. If Android still mounts the PSP as a USB drive, eject it in the system before unplugging the cable.
This TV has no compatible file picker. Configure an Android TV file manager and try again.
Import cancelled. The original is preserved.
Back in the Dock. Returning here alone does not prove that the game has closed; saves stay on this device.
USB permission was not granted. You can request it again.
The PSP has disconnected. Previous connection evidence is no longer valid.
Connect exactly one PSP to inspect or activate its controller.
The control channel requires validation on this device. No PSP files will be written.
Folder is readable. Physical identity and automatic safe removal remain unverified.
An earlier import was interrupted. Its temporary file was removed; the original is intact.
The PSP requested exit. Close the game, then eject the USB drive in Android.
PSP input stopped. Use the TV remote to continue.

PSP Dock will manage this PSP controller while the Dock or a game is open. Android will temporarily stop handling its buttons. USB storage is not changed and saves stay on this device. This preview still needs testing on your TV; keep its remote available. Use one game controller at a time: the PSP or another Android gamepad. Unplug and reconnect if another app needs the PSP afterwards.
